name: CLIENT-NAME-stores
description: Shopify Theme — eComplete base with client overlay

scripts.build: cd base && npm run webpack:build && cd .. && npm run merge
scripts.push: npm run merge && shopify theme push --path dist --nodelete
scripts.push:theme: npm run merge && shopify theme push --path dist --nodelete --theme
scripts.push:base: cd base && git push origin main && cd .. && git add base && git commit -m "chore: update base submodule" && git push
scripts.update:base: cd base && git pull origin main && cd .. && npm run build
